why_ai: Drug products are made by hand and machine in GMP plants, and a quality unit must sign every release; AI trims documentation and review but demand for physical manufacturing does not fall.
why_clarity: Specifications, master batch records and validated procedures define an exact product, and release testing checks each batch within days.
why_digital: Materials and equipment in, physical drug product out; CDMO capacity is bought globally, but the work itself is done on site.

why_ai: Molecule selection, patent challenges and exit calls are high-stakes judgements over long horizons, on top of physical tablet manufacturing.
why_clarity: Each molecule's forecast is checkable, but entry counts and erosion are known years later and selection methods vary by firm.
why_digital: Portfolio, patent and market data are digital; the products are physical and sold through a few wholesalers and GPOs.

why_ai: Patent challenges are adversarial and novel, argued by accountable counsel and experts, and the launch decision is high-stakes.
why_clarity: Statutory steps and dates are fixed, but each case turns on claims and courts, and outcomes take years.
why_digital: Filings, dockets and patents are documents; strategy is bought from specialist counsel nationally.

why_ai: Supplying awarded volume depends on physical plants and API supply, though planning and risk scoring automate.
why_clarity: Awarded volumes, fill rates and penalties are exact and measured every order.
why_digital: Planning data is digital; the product is physical and contracts are won through a few national buyers.

why_ai: Transfers run on physical equipment under accountable quality release, and sponsors choose CDMOs on trusted execution; outsourcing demand grows.
why_clarity: PPQ batches pass or fail against defined acceptance criteria, though each product transfer differs.
why_digital: Process knowledge arrives as documents, but the work is physical scale-up; sponsors buy CDMO capacity worldwide.

why_ai: Root-cause calls are judgement under a regulatory spotlight and QA signs them, but retrieval and drafting automate readily.
why_clarity: Investigations recur in a defined format, but whether a root cause was true is known only if the failure returns.
why_digital: Records and narratives in a QMS in, investigation reports out; some evidence gathering is on the floor.

why_ai: Inspections happen on site with accountable quality heads, and responses commit the firm before FDA; consultants with agency experience are trusted.
why_clarity: The response format is set out, but each inspection differs and FDA's verdict arrives months later.
why_digital: Inspection requests and responses are documents, while the inspection itself is in person.

why_ai: Creams, liquids and aerosols are made and filled in small plants under CGMP; demand for the products is unaffected by AI.
why_clarity: Monographs fix permitted ingredients and labels, and batches are tested to specification.
why_digital: Physical products made locally and sold to retailers' store-brand programmes.

why_ai: The sponsor's CMC lead is accountable for release and supplier oversight and makes judgement calls on deviations across suppliers.
why_clarity: Quality agreements define approvals, but each deviation and transfer differs and consequences surface late.
why_digital: Oversight runs entirely on documents and portals, often across borders.

why_ai: QA must sign release, but checking entries against a master record is mechanical work that review by exception and models take over.
why_clarity: The same master record is checked against the same limits batch after batch, with clear pass criteria.
why_digital: Paper and electronic records in, a release decision out; plants still hold many paper records.

why_ai: Case intake and coding are rule-bound document work that language models perform well; physicians keep causality and signal calls.
why_clarity: Minimum elements, MedDRA coding and the 15-day rule give exact, checkable outputs at high volume.
why_digital: Reports in, coded cases and filings out, routinely outsourced offshore.

why_ai: Reading and summarising regulation is work models do increasingly well, kept valuable by curated interpretation and trust.
why_clarity: Regulatory changes recur constantly and can be checked against the source text, though interpretation varies.
why_digital: Public regulatory text in, alerts and databases out, sold online worldwide.

why_ai: Assembling patent, approval and supplier records from public sources is extraction work models handle; analyst forecasts keep some value.
why_clarity: Records follow a fixed schema and forecasts are checked later by approvals and court rulings.
why_digital: Public data in, database and forecasts out online.

why_ai: Filing strategy carries regulatory consequence and experienced specialists are trusted, while dossier writing automates.
why_clarity: Module formats and change rules are codified, but FDA's response arrives months later.
why_digital: Dossiers and correspondence are prepared and filed electronically, often from offshore teams.

why_ai: Auditors walk plants and stand behind remediation and certification reports, often as former FDA staff.
why_clarity: CGMP sets the standard, but each remediation is bespoke and success shows at the next inspection.
why_digital: Site audits in person with document review, delivered as reports.

why_ai: Classifying and searching inspection documents is document work AI performs well.
why_clarity: Documents are classified to fixed CFR sections at volume and checked against the source.
why_digital: FOIA documents in, a searchable database out online.

why_ai: Licensed counsel and testifying experts act personally in adversarial, high-stakes cases.
why_clarity: Procedure is codified, but each case is argued afresh and outcomes take years.
why_digital: Briefs, reports and discovery are documents, with court appearances in person.

why_ai: Benchmark computation automates, but programmes rely on the trust of contributing sites.
why_clarity: Metrics are defined and recur each round, though their meaning for improvement is debated.
why_digital: Contributed data in, reports out, delivered remotely.

why_ai: Scale-up and troubleshooting judgement on new products is consequential, and models assist rather than replace it.
why_clarity: Models and risk assessments follow defined methods, checked by engineering and PPQ batches.
why_digital: Process data and models on screen, applied to physical plants.

why_ai: Case processing and report assembly are rule-bound work exposed to automation; signal judgement remains.
why_clarity: Cases and reports follow fixed formats and deadlines with objective checks.
why_digital: Entirely document and database work, delivered from offshore centres.

why_ai: Standards carry legal force through public trust in the institution, and reference standards are physical materials.
why_clarity: Monograph methods are codified and tested, but revisions are consensus work on slow cycles.
why_digital: Standards development is document work; reference standards ship physically worldwide.

why_ai: Choosing which molecules to file and challenge is a high-stakes judgement with long feedback.
why_clarity: Selection cases recur, but whether a call was right is known years later.
why_digital: Data and models on screen, with decisions taken in internal meetings.

why_ai: Testing requires physical samples and instruments in GMP labs with accountable sign-off.
why_clarity: Validated methods give pass or fail results against specification.
why_digital: Samples arrive physically; results go out as data to clients anywhere.

why_ai: Building features from customer data is software work AI-native competitors can match.
why_clarity: Features are defined and their use measurable on release cycles.
why_digital: Entirely software, delivered as cloud services.

why_ai: Surveillance and enforcement are statutory acts by accountable officials, with site selection increasingly model-driven.
why_clarity: Programmes are codified, but findings rest on judgement and outcomes take months.
why_digital: Surveillance analysis runs on registrations and inspection data, by a sole national authority.

why_ai: Members pay for convening and advocacy, which AI does not replace.
why_clarity: Outputs are loosely defined and impact is hard to measure.
why_digital: Guides are digital, but conferences and advocacy are in person.

why_ai: Pricing rare, severe liability and recall losses is accountable judgement within broker relationships.
why_clarity: Underwriting follows guidelines, but losses arrive years later.
why_digital: Submissions and policies are documents, placed through brokers.

why_ai: Clients hire specific bankers for bespoke, adversarial transactions.
why_clarity: Each deal is unique and success is judged long after closing.
why_digital: Data rooms are digital, but deals run on relationships and meetings.
